note: Isolated A/B against trial-050: identical config, only --pos-weight added (sqrt(n_negative/n_positive) per label, computed from the training split - range 0.61-69.14 across the 383 coarse GO terms, verified before launch). Tests whether upweighting rare-label positives in the loss recovers some of the gap between trial-050's threshold-0.5 recall (45.8%, from the post-hoc diagnostic - the training loop's own recall metric was unreliable until the finalize_metrics() fix landed this session) and its best-threshold recall, without needing manual threshold tuning at inference time. Everything else held identical to trial-050 for a clean comparison: unfreeze=1, lr=2e-4, batch=8, dropout=0.2, wd=0.5, epochs=10.
